violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety registered with RIDOH. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Dispenser was observed detached from wall. PIC stated dispensers would be re-installed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener was placed in dish pit. Slicer was already taken apart, needs to be properly washed rinsed and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Burgers are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The presence of flying insects is not controlled as evidenced by an accumulation in the bar area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Pest control company to be contacted to address pest activity. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the bar and kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The 3-bay sink plumbing was observed with a leak. Plumbing to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
The prep unit was observed turned on and maintaining an ambient temperature of 80 degrees. Once kitchen resumes use prep unit must be repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2024
The facility is lacking test strips for the high temperature dish washer and test strips for the 3-bay sink. Test strips to be ordered. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2024
